name: easy-scribe
description: Turn screen recordings into step-by-step guides, SOPs, tutorials and user docs with screenshots.

interface.longDescription:
Easy Scribe turns a screen recording into a step-by-step document with a screenshot at each step. Record yourself doing a task once, and Easy Scribe writes the instructions: numbered steps, the right screenshots, and clear wording, ready to share with your team or customers.

How it works in ChatGPT
- Attach a screen recording to your message and ask for a document, for example "Turn this into an SOP". Easy Scribe receives the video directly.
- Or ask without attaching anything, and an upload box appears in the chat. Drop the video in once and the document is created.
- Processing takes a few minutes. ChatGPT can then show you the finished document, summarise it, or share it with a link.

What it writes
- Step-by-step how-to guides
- Standard operating procedures (SOPs)
- User guides and tutorials
- Onboarding guides
- Troubleshooting guides
- Release notes and acceptance criteria

Easy Scribe reads what happens on screen as well as any narration, so recordings without audio work too. It writes in the language spoken in the video, or in another language you ask for.

Every document is saved to your Easy Scribe library, where you can edit it, add or replace screenshots, and export it to PDF, Word or Markdown.

You sign in with your Easy Scribe account. Easy Scribe only sees the recordings you send it and the documents in your account, and no tool deletes or overwrites anything.
defaultPrompt: Turn my screen recording into a step-by-step guide.
Make an SOP from this recording.
Show my latest Easy Scribe document as Markdown.

positive.description: Start from a request with no file yet
positive.prompt: Use Easy Scribe to make a step-by-step guide from my screen recording.
positive.expected_behavior: The Easy Scribe upload box appears in the chat. After a video is dropped in, the box shows upload progress, then "Writing" with an Open in Easy Scribe button, and later "is ready".

positive.prompt: Turn this recording into an SOP. (attach a short .mp4 or .mov screen recording)
positive.expected_behavior: Easy Scribe receives the attached video through the video file input and returns a document_id with status pending and a link to the document. No upload box is needed.

positive.description: Check on and read a document
positive.prompt: Is my Easy Scribe document ready? Show me the steps.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent documents, then returns the newest document's status and, when completed, its content as Markdown with screenshot links.

positive.prompt: What kinds of documents can Easy Scribe write?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the eight formats: General, SOP, User guide, Acceptance criteria, Tutorial, Onboarding guide, Release notes and Troubleshooting guide.

positive.prompt: Create a share link for my latest Easy Scribe document.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a share link and an embed URL for the newest completed document in the test account.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: Page link instead of a video file
negative.prompt: Make a guide from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ with Easy Scribe.
negative.expected_behavior: create_document returns a clear error that the link opens a web page rather than a video file and suggests uploading the file instead. No document is created.

negative.prompt: Write an SOP for onboarding new employees.
negative.expected_behavior: Easy Scribe is not used, because there is no recording; ChatGPT answers directly or asks whether the user has a screen recording.

review.commerce_description: Easy Scribe does not sell anything or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: turn screen recordings into documentation from ChatGPT.
